# Siddharth Srinivasan

> Official portfolio of Siddharth Srinivasan, a Mumbai-based cinematographer and director of photography.

## Overview
Siddharth Srinivasan works across commercials, films and long-form narrative productions. His portfolio focuses on composition, naturalistic lighting, atmosphere and storytelling. He is based in Mumbai, India and available worldwide.

## Official website
- [Siddharth Srinivasan — Portfolio](https://www.siddharthsrinivasan.com/): Biography, selected cinematography, narratives, commercial work and enquiries.

## Selected narrative work
- Kaala — webseries
- Duet — short film
- Perfect Justice — feature film
- Guilty Minds — series
- Ave Maria — short film
